statement: All colour, type family, radius and focus values in Unbound UI MUST come from Forma semantic tokens (--forma-color-*, --forma-type-*, --forma-space-*, --forma-primitive-radius-*, --forma-primitive-size-target-min) as set by a brand manifest compiled with Forma's BrandCompiler. Application CSS MAY derive values (color-mix) from those tokens but MUST NOT declare --forma-* properties or hard-code hex colours. The Unbound default brand ('unbound-default') MUST use the Balanced Charcoal and Bronze values of the Echelon theme 1.1.0 manifest (kemiller2002/echelon-design-system theme/echelon.brand.json): charcoal #202421 chrome/heading, carbon #171a18 text, parchment #f2efe7 canvas, oxide bronze #905831 accent (#a87e5e dark), with Newsreader, Manrope and IBM Plex Mono self-hosted under SIL OFL 1.1. The README candidate palette (#20252A, #B7844B, ...) MUST NOT be used: it is unverified.

acceptance_criteria.given: the v2 prototype CSS
acceptance_criteria.when: it is scanned for '--forma-' declarations and hex colour literals outside documented derivations
acceptance_criteria.then: there are none; every colour resolves from a --forma-color-* token

acceptance_criteria.given: the unbound-default brand manifest
acceptance_criteria.when: it is compiled with Forma's BrandCompiler
acceptance_criteria.then: compilation passes and the output values equal echelon.brand.json for every colour role

acceptance_criteria.given: a sponsor manifest (example-harbor)
acceptance_criteria.when: it is swapped in without other changes
acceptance_criteria.then: every v2 screen restyles, and the verification harness passes at all five viewports

title: Application type scale
statement: Application screens MUST use a fixed application type scale, not Forma's marketing display sizes (fluid-display-1 up to 7.25rem with a 14ch heading measure): page title clamp(1.5rem, 1.3rem + 0.8vw, 1.875rem) weight 650; section title 1.125rem; body 1rem/1.5; small 0.875rem; micro 0.8125rem (minimum for any text). Headings MUST NOT have a character measure that wraps short titles. The display face (Newsreader in the default brand) is reserved for the one headline money figure per screen; all other text uses the sans face. Labels and chips use sentence case in the body face; uppercase monospace labels MUST NOT be used for status or navigation.

acceptance_criteria.then: no text is smaller than 13 px and the h1 is between 24 and 30 px

title: Spacing and density
statement: Spacing MUST use Forma's eight-step scale (--forma-space-1..8 = 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 3 rem): 4 within controls, 12-16 between related items, 20-24 between panels, 32-48 between page regions. Two densities are defined: comfortable (donor, advisor, charity, widget; table rows at least 44 px) and compact (staff work queues and ledgers; rows at least 36 px with 24 px targets). Density MUST be a single switch per surface class, not per component; Forma has no density token (FORMA-GAP-18).

acceptance_criteria.then: every gap equals 20 px (space-5)

acceptance_criteria.given: a staff queue in compact density
acceptance_criteria.when: row heights and target sizes are measured
acceptance_criteria.then: rows are at least 36 px tall and every interactive target is at least 24 by 24 px

title: Colour roles and semantic status
statement: Colour roles are: canvas (surface-primary), raised panel (derived, lighter than canvas), sunken (derived), chrome (surface-inverse) with text-inverse, accent (accent-primary) for the single primary action, the active navigation rule and the 'available' allocation segment only, and four status roles (success, warning, danger, info). Status colour MUST always be paired with a glyph and words. Accent MUST NOT be used for status. Secondary text (text-secondary) MUST NOT be placed on surface-secondary or sunken surfaces (Echelon AUDIT §6: it fails 4.5:1 there); use text-on-secondary-surface.

title: Interaction states
statement: Every interactive component MUST define rest, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled-with-reason, busy and error states. Focus-visible is a 3 px focus-ring outline with 2 px offset plus a 2 px focus-gap halo, so it is visible on canvas, raised and chrome surfaces. Disabled controls that the user might expect to use MUST show why (FORMA-GAP-11); controls the user can never use MUST be omitted. Busy state uses aria-busy on the control and keeps its label.

title: Iconography
statement: Icons MUST come from the Forma icon registry (80 icons, 24 px grid, 1.8 stroke, round caps), rendered at 16, 20 or 24 px, decorative (aria-hidden) beside visible text, or named by the parent control's aria-label when standalone. title: Sponsor white-labelling
statement: A sponsor brand MUST be a Forma brand manifest (identity, fonts, radius, light and dark colour maps, terms) compiled with Forma's BrandCompiler and passing its contrast checks. Every application-layer component MUST be brand-agnostic (derived from --forma-* tokens, no brand selector), so a sponsor brand restyles the whole product. statement: Dialogs are reserved for consequential confirmation (G-005), unknown-outcome resolution and destructive actions. statement: Forms are single-column with labels above fields, help text tied by aria-describedby, required fields marked in words, inline validation on blur or submit (never while typing a number), an error summary at the top linking to each field, and entered values preserved. Amount fields accept '$', commas and spaces, use inputmode=decimal and echo the parsed amount in words beside the field. Redundant entry is avoided (WCAG 3.3.7).

title: Case workspace frame (typed panels)
statement: UNB-UI-S-009 MUST be implemented as one frame with these regions in order: (1) Case header - work-item reference (G-016), subject reference and subject status lozenge, work-item status, owner, preparer, age against SLA, and the blocked outcome; (2) Rule that raised it - creating rule id and version, the condition that fired, and the exit condition that will close the item automatically; (3) Evidence region - typed evidence from the selected panel, each fact with source and freshness (G-003), conflicting sources side by side, and an evidence snapshot id; (4) Panel slot - exactly one typed decision panel (UNB-UI-P-*); (5) Decision record - proposed and recorded decisions with decider, authority, rationale, evidence snapshot and resulting subject transition, append-only; (6) AI summary flyout - opened by 'Explain', labelled 'AI-generated, not a decision' with sources, with no consequential controls (G-011); (7) Handoff - a handoff summary of what was done, what is pending and who acts next, plus reassignment. If no panel is registered for a type, the slot MUST show 'No decision panel for this case type' and offer only Request evidence and Escalate; it MUST NOT fall back to a generic approve control. Recording a decision writes the WFM-23 decision record and issues the panel's subject transition; if execution fails the item shows 'Reopened' with the failure reason. Request evidence and Escalate are frame actions available in every panel; the frame MUST NOT offer bulk decisions across cases except the RCD-005 batch grant approval, which lives in the inbox (UNB-UI-S-008).
